clues.text: When the Israelites were numbered, each man paid the LORD a ransom so no plague would come.
In the wilderness, Moses was told to list every man of Israel by clan and family, name by name.
God told Moses not to number the tribe of Levi in this along with the other Israelites.
God said all twenty or older counted in this would fall in the wilderness for grumbling.
Satan rose up against Israel and stirred King David to take this of Israel.
Joab son of Zeruiah began this count but did not finish, and wrath came upon Israel.
Gamaliel told the Sanhedrin that Judas the Galilean rose up in the days of this and drew people after him.
